testPlan.title: Issue 28 settings page + issue 18 wheel zoom

test.title: The game loaded this test version
test.hint: This ticks by itself. Nothing to do.

test.title: Make the editor big
test.hint: Open the editor settings (more settings...). Set ui scale to 1.5 x or more. Then click PASS.

test.title: The settings page fits
test.hint: Look at the page. You can reach the title and the close button, and nothing is cut off. PASS if so.

test.title: The wheel scrolls the page
test.hint: Roll the wheel over the rows. The page moves, a bar on the right shows where you are, and no value changes. PASS if so.

test.title: The + button still works
test.hint: Scroll down to LAUNCH BUTTON. Click + on position. The position changes. PASS if so.

test.title: Set the size back
test.hint: Set ui scale back to 1.0 x. Then click PASS.

test.title: Small page: the wheel changes values
test.hint: Roll the wheel over a value. The value changes, as before. PASS if so.

test.title: Button set to right stays on screen
test.hint: Set position to right. Close the editor. With AutoDrive's box at the right edge, the button sits on its left, fully on screen. PASS if so.

test.title: Button near the top stays on screen
test.hint: Set position to above. Drag AutoDrive's box to the top edge. The button stays on screen. Set it back the way you like it, then PASS.

test.title: In a vehicle: open and close the editor
test.passLog: exit: the screen is on the vehicle's camera
test.hint: Sit in a vehicle. Press Alt+F, then Esc. This ticks by itself.

test.title: The wheel zooms the vehicle camera
test.hint: Roll the wheel. The camera zooms in and out. PASS if so.

test.title: Run the wheel report
test.hint: Open the console (~). Type FlyoverWheelReport and press Enter. One line appears. PASS if so.

test.title: Clicking a vehicle from above does not enter it
test.hint: Open the editor. With the Select tool, left-click a parked vehicle. You stay where you are and the editor stays open. PASS if so.

test.title: Leave the vehicle with the editor open
test.hint: In a vehicle: Alt+F, then leave or switch vehicle any way you can, then Esc. The wheel still zooms where you are. SKIP if nothing lets you leave.
